title: A neuroprosthesis translates attempted speech at 62 words per minute
summary: For a participant with ALS, intracortical electrodes and an AI algorithm converted attempted speech into text at 62 words per minute. With a 125,000-word vocabulary, the error rate was 23.8%, versus 9.1% for only 50 words. Proof of concept in one person, with an invasive implant and experimental device.
ai_technology: Neural network for phoneme decoding and language model

evidence.tested: One participant with ALS attempted speech in real time; word error rates were measured at 50-word and 125,000-word vocabularies, with decoding at 62 words per minute.
evidence.unknown: The abstract states no limitations; the results come from one participant, the large-vocabulary error rate (23.8%) is substantial and decoding is well below conversational speed.
evidence.ai_role: An AI algorithm decoded spiking activity from intracortical microelectrode arrays into text.
